sql.if: AND ( (o.orderType = 1 AND o.travelDate >= CURDATE()) OR (o.orderType = 2 AND DATE_ADD(o.travelDate, INTERVAL GREATEST(COALESCE(o.`count`, 1), 1) DAY) >= CURDATE()) )

mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.orderNo, o.userId, o.ticketId, o.orderType, o.hotelId, o.`count`, o.status, o.createTime, o.travelDate, o.totalPrice, o.person_name AS personName, o.phone AS phone, COALESCE(t.name, h.name, '') AS ticketName, h.name AS hotelName FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN ticket t ON o.ticketId = t.id LEFT JOIN hotel h ON o.hotelId = h.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
